title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Certificate… (CVE-2026-91897)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 have an improper certificate validation vulnerability. This flaw could allow a high privileged local attacker to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service. The vulnerability requires local access and high privileges to exploit.
